summary.headline: Advantia Health captures $875K in annual savings across 10 sourcing workstreams
summary.narrative: Treya Partners’ strategic–sourcing engagement delivered $684,936 in fully-locked annual savings across six categories while a further $189,484 is advancing through contracting and RFP stages. Key wins include a 9% fee reduction with Athena for revenue-cycle management, a 14% cut on medical-supply distribution costs, and a 19% savings shift to an in-house sonography staffing model. Additional opportunities in IT managed services, lab reagents, telecom, and office supplies are moving toward implementation, positioning Advantia for nearly $0.9M of recurring savings once final paperwork is executed.
